description: Duet Hook (experimental wrapper) — Experimental duet or stitch ideation wrapper. Provide target.handle, target.platform, the target video context, and your brand. Current caveat: the market wrapper is unstable and may return only partial text or an empty response even when the upstream run succeeds. Buy it for pipeline testing, not for guaranteed ready-to-post copy. (3 MESH/call, a tool · marketing)

brand.description: REQUIRED — your brand: who the duet is for and what it should sell.

target.description: REQUIRED — the video and account to duet or stitch.

platform.description: REQUIRED — the platform the target video is on.

video_context.description: The target video context — what the video is about, its hook, or a link to it.
